call_contract.count_field: obj+0x54, signed 32-bit, read at entry and re-read after every call
call_contract.dynamic_count_consequence: a callee that raises the count extends the run; a callee that lowers it to at most the next index ends the run early
call_contract.empty_arm: count <= 0 returns at once, no callee call

loop.index_step: index copied to r8d, then incremented before the call; loop continues while re-read count > incremented index (signed)

call_contract.stable_count_consequence: exactly N calls, indices 0..N-1, for stable count N > 0

caller_site.note: site conditions only; caller semantics not claimed

not_claimed: caller function semantics beyond the site conditions
meaning of arguments a, b, c, the flag byte, or the count field beyond the loop bound
any callee effect on obj fields other than the re-read count at +0x54

windows.name: indexed_call_loop
windows.role: whole function, modelled end to end
